motion.transition.color.description: Colour, ground and border changes on controls.

motion.transition.surface.description: Card ground and text colour on hover.

motion.transition.reveal.description: Rise-in of page blocks (with a stagger delay).

motion.transition.anchor.description: Heading anchor reveal (delay drops to 0 on direct hover).

motion.transition.settle.description: Tilted cards settling on hover: they straighten to interaction.tilt.settle-factor of their tilt, lift interaction.lift.settle and scale to interaction.scale.settle.

motion.transition.sheet-enter.description: Bottom sheet and full-screen menu entering.

motion.transition.sheet-settle.description: Bottom sheet settling after a drag: back to its detent when the drag does not dismiss it, or up to the large detent.

motion.transition.gesture-settle.description: A released swipe row or pull-to-refresh indicator settling: back to rest, open at its actions, or held at the refresh position.

motion.transition.badge-enter.description: A badge appearing on its host (it scales up from component.badge.enter-scale as it fades in).

motion.animation.heartbeat.description: Pulse ring behind a live element, scaled from the pulse origin.

motion.animation.loader-fill.description: Loader: cells fill and empty in sequence (reading, spiral or rise order; motion.loader.fill-step apart). 'on' is fill-on for pattern cells, fill-other for the rest.

motion.animation.loader-twinkle.description: Loader: cells twinkle (alternate). Each cell draws its own cycle (twinkle-duration-min to -max) and start offset. 'on' is twinkle-on for pattern cells, twinkle-other for the rest.

motion.animation.loader-emerge.description: Loader: the pattern holds at full ink while the other cells flash on and off around it (loader duration x 1.6; per-cell delays emerge-delay-min to -max).

motion.animation.loader-emerge-slow.description: Loader: slow emerge, track a (loader duration x 2.6). Each non-pattern cell runs track a, b or c with its own delay (emerge-slow-delay-min to -max).

motion.animation.loader-emerge-slow-b.description: Loader: slow emerge, track b: two steps up, a step down, rest.

motion.animation.loader-emerge-slow-c.description: Loader: slow emerge, track c: on, a flicker, on, a dip and a flicker, rest.

motion.animation.loader-emerge-drift.description: Loader: drifting emerge (loader duration x 2.7): a step up, full, a step down, rest (per-cell delays emerge-drift-delay-min to -max).

motion.animation.loader-sparse.description: Loader: sparse two-phase emerge; each non-pattern cell draws peaks p1 and p2 from the peaks list, its cycle (sparse-duration-min to -max) and start offset.

motion.animation.loader-sparse-fast.description: Loader: sparse emerge, fast (sparse-fast-duration-min to -max per cell).

motion.animation.loader-drop.description: Loader: pattern cells drop into place one after another (motion.loader.drop-step apart), hold, then fade.

motion.animation.loader-chase.description: Loader: a lit cell chases around the pattern (loader duration x 0.7; cells motion.loader.chase-step of the loader duration apart).

motion.animation.loader-spin.description: Loader: the pattern turns once per cycle in four 90-degree steps.

motion.animation.loader-orbit.description: Loader: the centre column breathes (squashes vertically) while the ring cells step round it (motion.loader.orbit-steps per cycle).

motion.animation.hero-lift.description: Scroll-driven lift of the fill hero: moves up 40vh across the first 80vh of scroll (regular widths, motion allowed).

motion.animation.screen-in-forward.description: Forward navigation (a push): the incoming screen slides in from the inline end by interaction.shift.screen as it fades in.

motion.animation.screen-out-forward.description: Forward navigation: the outgoing screen moves toward the inline start as it fades out.

motion.animation.screen-in-back.description: Back navigation (a pop): the screen returned to comes back from the inline start; quicker than a push.

motion.animation.screen-out-back.description: Back navigation: the screen being left moves toward the inline end as it fades out.

motion.animation.screen-fade-in.description: Switching between peer screens (tab bar destinations, segmented views): the new screen fades in, without movement.

motion.animation.screen-fade-out.description: Switching between peer screens: the old screen fades out.

motion.animation.modal-in.description: A full-screen modal (compose, edit) rising from interaction.shift.modal below as it fades in.

motion.animation.modal-out.description: A full-screen modal sinking as it fades out.

motion.animation.skeleton-pulse.description: Skeleton placeholders breathe between full opacity and opacity.50; they hold still under reduced motion.

motion.animation.refresh-spin.description: Pull to refresh: the indicator turns while the refresh runs (one turn per cycle); under reduced motion it holds still and the status line says Refreshing.

motion.loader.rest.description: Resting cell opacity between beats (fill, emerge, sparse, tetris).

motion.loader.fill-on.description: Fill loader: pattern cells at full ink.

motion.loader.fill-step.description: Fill loaders: delay between consecutive cells as a fraction of the loader duration (reading, spiral and rise orders).

motion.loader.twinkle-offset-min.description: Twinkle loader: smallest start offset (each cell starts this far into its cycle; a negative animation delay).

motion.loader.sparse-offset-min.description: Sparse loader: smallest start offset (each cell starts this far into its cycle; a negative animation delay).

motion.loader.sparse-fast-offset-min.description: Sparse-fast loader: smallest start offset (each cell starts this far into its cycle; a negative animation delay).

motion.loader.chase-step.description: Chase loader: delay between consecutive cells round the pattern, as a fraction of the loader duration.

motion.loader.emerge-on.description: Emerge loaders: pattern cells hold at full ink; other cells peak here.

motion.loader.emerge-delay-min.description: Emerge loader: shortest per-cell start delay.

motion.loader.emerge-delay-max.description: Emerge loader: longest per-cell start delay.

motion.loader.emerge-slow-delay-min.description: Emerge slow loader: shortest per-cell start delay.

motion.loader.emerge-slow-delay-max.description: Emerge slow loader: longest per-cell start delay.

motion.loader.emerge-drift-delay-min.description: Emerge drift loader: shortest per-cell start delay.

motion.loader.emerge-drift-delay-max.description: Emerge drift loader: longest per-cell start delay.

motion.loader.slow-a-rise.description: Slow emerge, track a: first step up.

motion.loader.slow-a-fall.description: Slow emerge, track a: step down before rest.

motion.loader.slow-b-rise.description: Slow emerge, track b: first step up.

motion.loader.slow-b-lift.description: Slow emerge, track b: second step up.

motion.loader.slow-b-fall.description: Slow emerge, track b: step down before rest.

motion.loader.slow-c-flicker.description: Slow emerge, track c: flicker between full steps.

motion.loader.slow-c-dip.description: Slow emerge, track c: dip before the last flicker.

motion.loader.drift-rise.description: Drifting emerge: step up before full.

motion.loader.drift-fall.description: Drifting emerge: step down before rest.

motion.loader.drop-offset.description: Drop loader: start offset of a falling cell.

motion.loader.drop-step.description: Drop loader: delay between consecutive pattern cells (reading order).

motion.loader.spin-turn.description: Spin loader: one full turn per cycle, taken in steps.

motion.loader.orbit-squash.description: Orbit loader: vertical scale of the centre column at mid-cycle.

motion.loader.orbit-steps.description: Orbit loader: steps per cycle; on each step the pattern cells of the ring round the centre move one place clockwise (the source orbits the six cells of its mark in six steps; the 3 x 3 ring of a 5 x 5 grid has eight places). Each step is a whole step (steps(1, end)).

motion.loader.tetris-steps.description: Tetris loader: the cycle is this many equal steps; cells change only on step boundaries (steps(1, end) per keyframe). Pattern cells land one per step from the bottom row up and hold.

motion.loader.tetris-flash-step.description: Tetris loader: step at which the completed pattern dims to tetris-dim; it lights on the next step, dims again, then clears.

motion.loader.tetris-clear-steps.description: Tetris-clear loader: steps per cycle (whole steps, as the tetris loader).

motion.loader.tetris-clear-flash-step.description: Tetris-clear loader: step at which the completed pattern dims.

motion.loader.tetris-dim.description: Tetris loaders: a completed pattern dims to this opacity twice before clearing.

motion.scroll-lift.distance.description: Scroll lift: how far the fill hero rises (vh).

motion.scroll-lift.range.description: Scroll lift: scroll distance over which it rises (vh from the top).

motion.reduced.duration.description: Every duration under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Tilts, lifts, reveals, scroll lift and loader animation stop; opacity changes remain instant.

effect.blur.radius.description: Blur applied to text in the blur effect.

effect.blur.shift.description: Vertical echo offset of the blur effect (text-shadow 1x and 2x).

effect.grain.paper-opacity.description: Opacity of the paper layer of grained headlines.

effect.grain.offset.description: Vertical offset of the front grain layer.

effect.grain.alpha-gain.description: Noise alpha gain (feColorMatrix alpha row, first term).

effect.grain.alpha-offset.description: Noise alpha offset (feColorMatrix alpha row, last term).

effect.grain.region-x.description: Filter region x, relative to the text box (%).

effect.grain.back.blur.description: Soft back layer. Blur of the glyph alpha before the noise is subtracted.

effect.grain.back.edge.description: Soft back layer. Weight of the blurred glyph against the noise (arithmetic k2).

effect.grain.back.contrast.description: Soft back layer. Stipple contrast (alpha slope).

effect.grain.front.blur.description: Crisp front layer. Blur of the glyph alpha before the noise is subtracted.

effect.grain.front.edge.description: Crisp front layer. Weight of the blurred glyph against the noise (arithmetic k2).

effect.grain.front.contrast.description: Crisp front layer. Stipple contrast (alpha slope).

effect.grain.paper.blur.description: Paper-coloured layer that bites into the ink. Blur of the glyph alpha before the noise is subtracted.

effect.grain.paper.seed.description: Paper-coloured layer that bites into the ink. Noise seed.

effect.grain.paper.edge.description: Paper-coloured layer that bites into the ink. Weight of the blurred glyph against the noise (arithmetic k2).

effect.grain.paper.contrast.description: Paper-coloured layer that bites into the ink. Stipple contrast (alpha slope).

effect.pixelate.max.description: Largest pixel block (px) at the start of the pixelate effect.

effect.pixelate.hold-ratio.description: Pixelate hold variant: resting block size as a fraction of the maximum.

effect.noise.passes.description: Noise: jittered copies painted per frame.

effect.noise.settle-spread.description: Noise: share of the spread kept in the jitter radius as the effect settles (the radius eases from max to spread x this).

effect.draw.ms-per-100px.description: Draw-in speed: milliseconds per 100px of path.

effect.contour.gap.description: Gap between contour lines, relative to glyph size.

effect.contour.lines.description: Contour: number of offset outlines drawn around the word.

effect.reveal.threshold.description: Share of an element that must be visible before its reveal or effect starts.

effect.reveal.inset-bottom.description: The trigger area stops this far above the bottom of the viewport (% of its height), so effects start once the element is clearly in view.

effect.marker.color.description: Highlighter marker ink: multiplied into the paper in light mode; in dark mode a deep teal band drawn normally behind cream text.

effect.outline.sweep-angle.description: Direction the ink fills outlined text (deg; 90 = from the start edge). The fill is a hard-stop gradient twice the text width that slides across (effect.outline stroke, motion.transition.outline-fill).

effect.mark.strike.stroke-ratio.description: Strike-through scribble. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.underline.stroke-ratio.description: Hand-drawn underline. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.underline-thick.stroke-ratio.description: Thick marker underline. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.bubble.stroke-ratio.description: Speech-bubble outline. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.bubble.pad-x.description: Speech bubble: space between the word and the outline, left and right (added to 7% of the word width).

effect.mark.bubble.pad-y.description: Speech bubble: space between the word and the outline, above and below (added to 12% of the line box).

effect.mark.bubble.corner-max.description: Speech bubble: largest corner size (the corner is 55% of the line box up to this).

effect.mark.bubble.close-overshoot-x.description: Speech bubble: how far the stroke runs past its start where it closes, horizontally (the hand-drawn overlap).

effect.mark.bubble.close-overshoot-y.description: Speech bubble: how far the closing stroke drifts from its start, vertically.

effect.mark.scribble.stroke-ratio.description: Zig-zag scribble. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.rays.stroke-ratio.description: Emphasis rays. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.circle.stroke-ratio.description: Hand-drawn circle. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.box.stroke-ratio.description: Hand-drawn box. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.focus.stroke-ratio.description: Focus corners. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.wave.stroke-ratio.description: Wavy underline. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.cut.stroke-ratio.description: Cut line. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.question.stroke-ratio.description: Question squiggle. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.marker.stroke-ratio.description: Highlighter band behind the word. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.marker.stroke-min.description: Highlighter band behind the word. Minimum stroke.

effect.mark.redact.stroke-ratio.description: Redaction bar over the word. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.redact.stroke-min.description: Redaction bar over the word. Minimum stroke.

effect.mark.ticks.stroke-ratio.description: Measured rule with end ticks. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.mark.ticks.stroke-min.description: Measured rule with end ticks. Minimum stroke.

effect.mark.bleed.description: Room left around every mark's path inside its drawing box, so strokes and their round caps are never clipped. The room is transparent.

effect.redact.in.description: Redact: bar draws across the word.

effect.redact.hold.description: Redact: bar holds on hover before lifting.

effect.redact.out.description: Redact: bar lifts off the word.

effect.wipe.hold.description: Wipe: hold between sweeps on hover.

effect.wipe.edge.description: Wipe: width of the soft sweep edge as a fraction of the word width.

effect.dissolve.duration.description: Dissolve: particles settle into the word.

effect.dissolve.particles.description: Dissolve: target number of particles across the word box (the particle size follows).

effect.dissolve.stagger.description: Dissolve: particles start moving across this share of the sweep, one after another.

effect.dissolve.window.description: Dissolve: share of the sweep one particle takes to leave or return.

effect.dissolve.sweep.description: Dissolve: length of the whole sweep in the same units: stagger plus window, plus a hold while every particle is away.

effect.dissolve.scatter-x.description: Dissolve: horizontal scatter range of a particle, in line box heights (centred on its place in the word).

effect.dissolve.rise-min.description: Dissolve: least a particle rises, in line box heights.

effect.dissolve.rise-range.description: Dissolve: extra rise a particle may take on top of rise-min, in line box heights.

effect.speak.duration.description: Speak: the word types in behind a voice meter.

effect.speak.bars.description: Speak: bars in the voice meter that leads the reveal.

effect.speak.bar-width.description: Speak: meter bar width as a fraction of the line box height.

effect.speak.bar-height.description: Speak: tallest meter bar, above and below the centre line, as a fraction of the line box height (bars shorten towards the tail).

effect.speak.bar-jitter.description: Speak: a bar's height varies between this share of its height and the full height, redrawn each frame.

effect.speak.bar-pitch.description: Speak: distance from one bar's start to the next, in bar widths. The gap before the first bar, at the reveal edge, matches the gap between bars.

effect.pulse.origin-y.description: Heartbeat ring transform origin, vertical (%): slightly below centre, under the glyph's optical middle.

effect.pulse.start-opacity.description: Ring opacity as a beat starts.

effect.pulse.beat-scale.description: Ring scale at the first beat (14% of the cycle).

effect.pulse.beat-opacity.description: Ring opacity at the first beat.

effect.pulse.echo-scale.description: Ring scale as it settles between beats (26% of the cycle).

effect.pulse.echo-opacity.description: Ring opacity as it settles between beats.

effect.pulse.peak-scale.description: Largest ring scale in a beat (42% to the end of the cycle, fading out).

effect.progress.played.description: Played portion of media progress on dark fills.

effect.progress.unplayed.description: Unplayed portion of media progress on dark fills.
